endpoint: https://tathabbut.vercel.app/api/verify (Vercel frontend proxy -> Render tathabbut-api, deploy fe9036b)
method: Run from the built-in browser on the owner's Mac, same-origin fetch to /api/verify, sequential requests. Inputs were read from the published repository (docs/evidence/local-safety-v0.9.0-2026-10-06.json run 1, docs/evidence/five-cases-local-v0.8.0-2026-10-06.json, data/evaluation/live-quran-sample-v0.7.1.json).

roundtrip_ms.note: Browser-to-Vercel-to-Render round trip from Riyadh; the slowest single request was the verse 17:69 quote.

summary.http_status: 147/147 release requests returned 200; the other 317 returned a parsed verdict response (status not recorded separately)

notes: Per-case verdicts equal the expected lists in every run; the 'actual' field is recorded as equal because the browser check compared JSON-serialised verdict lists and reported zero mismatches.
For the Quran sample the browser confirmed each returned source id is in the case's accepted list; the exact id is not copied here when several are accepted.
The frontend card wording for a single 'باطل' grade (frontend/lib/advice.ts) was published in a later upload; this file covers the API results only.
